newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Britain's Prince Charles to visit South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles to visit South Africa.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles will visit South Africa from October 30 at the invitation of President Nelson Mandela, the British Consulate General said on Thursday.

The heir to the British throne is to arrive in South Africa after a two-day visit to the neighbouring kingdom of Swaziland. He will also make a brief stop in Lesotho on October 31 to attend the coronation of King Letsie III in the tiny landlocked nation.
Prince Charles will return to South Africa after the coronation and will be in the country until November 5.
The British Consulate General said in a statement details of his itinerary would be available later in the year.
Queen Elizabeth toured South Africa in March 1995, welcoming it back to the Commonwealth after a 34-year absence and awarding Mandela the Order of Merit.

Mandela made a triumphant state visit to Britain in July 1996, at the queen's invitation. He was accompanied by Prince Charles during an 80-minute tour of London's rundown inner city area that is home to one of Britain's biggest black communities.
